items.name: Utah Open 2009

venue.name: [University of Utah](http://www.utah.edu/)
venue.address: 1495 E. 100 South, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

items.information: The tournament begins at 9:30 AM. Pre-registration is $5 for the first event, plus $1 for each additional event.  On-sight registration is $10 for the first event, plus $2 for each additional event.  Pizza and drinks will be provided for competitors. Non-competitors will have to pay $2 for food and drink. Pre-registration will be CLOSED Thursday, April 9th.
